results.original_title: The Hauntings of Richey Suncoast Theatre
results.overview: A documentary examining the alleged hauntings at Richey Suncoast Theatre, a community theater in New Port Richey, Florida.

results.title: El extraño
results.overview: A drunkard is visited by death incarnate, warning he's on a doomed path. The man decides to cheat death in a desperate attempt to survive.

results.title: Tales of Ardenmore
results.overview: A brash knight-in-training must partner with the woman he spurned, on a quest to save his brother from an undead sorcerer. Together they must overcome rogue warriors, monsters and magic.

results.title: One Last Day In The UK
results.original_title: One Last Day In The UK
results.overview: On her 28th birthday, Kyle is determined to enjoy a special day with Kieran, her partner of four years. As they move through London together, Kieran fills their day with thoughtful surprises, affection and moments that remind Kyle of why she fell in love with him. But beneath the celebrations, something feels wrong. Kieran is distracted, unusually emotional and increasingly desperate to make the day perfect, while Kyle struggles with the familiar loneliness she has felt within their relationship. As the day unfolds, the couple find themselves caught between the love they still share and the difficult realities neither of them has been willing to confront. What begins as a celebration of their life together gradually becomes an emotionally charged reckoning with what their future might look like. One Last Day in the UK is an intimate Black queer romantic drama about love, loneliness, sacrifice and the painful moment when loving someone may no longer be enough to stay together.

results.title: Rose Tinted
results.overview: The IRIS glasses can make anyone in front of you look like a completely different person. This is Maddie's last resort.

results.title: Hand Me Downs
results.overview: For nearly three decades, Death Skateboards has carved out its own place in British skateboarding. As the UK’s oldest skateboard company, its legacy has been shaped by the generations of riders who have carried it forward, each leaving their own mark on the team and the culture surrounding it. Through its past, present and future, the film explores how a legacy is built, passed down and kept alive, and what it means to be part of something that extends far beyond skateboarding itself.

results.title: The Cost of Dreaming
results.overview: Every year, millions of people decide to pursue a creative career. Few are prepared for what it asks of them. Through deeply personal stories from artists across different disciplines, The Cost of Dreaming explores the sacrifices, uncertainty and emotional reality hidden behind the pursuit of artistic success

results.title: Whiskey Priest
results.overview: The film follows a man struggling to balance a life of crime with a life of piety, as he is forced to confront his sins to both masters. How they praise him may be different, but it is through his struggle between both worlds that he tries to answer the question- can you faithfully serve two masters?

results.title: Moonlight in Golden Gai
results.overview: A small bar in Shinjuku's Golden Gai brings together its owner and a circle of regulars. Across 35 years of changing eras, their conversations trace ambitions, disappointments and the lives they continue to build.

results.title: Pining for Douglas
results.overview: When an overworked social media manager returns home for Christmas, she finds herself torn between saving her hometown's beloved 150-year-old Douglas Fir and a budding romance with the son of the tech giant's CEO who plans to chop it down.

results.title: Dead Man’s Party
results.overview: Stacy recalls a horrible incident that happened a year ago at a party she hosted.

results.title: Mr. Lucky
results.overview: Lakshman, an IT professional ironically nicknamed Lucky, finds himself trapped in a life full of misfortune. Everything changes when a mysterious cap turns his luck around, taking his life in unexpected directions.

results.title: The Vending Machine at the End of the World
results.original_title: The Vending Machine at the End of the World
results.overview: Minutes before an asteroid impact that will wipe out humanity, three friends decide the last thing they want to do before they die is get a bag of chips from a nearby vending machine.

results.title: your_tomorrow_will_never_come.mp4
results.overview: 15-year-old Lisa finds an old video camera and begins filming an ordinary, sobering winter morning in the apartment of her friend Maxim, who is clearly in love with her.

results.title: Otter Lake
results.overview: A year in the life of choreographer Emma Portner as she creates new work, confronts personal and physical challenges, and searches for artistic freedom between Otter Lake and Europe.

results.title: Women Around Me
results.overview: The story of three women who are undergoing a transformation of their lives due to the events caused by the Great War. Yaryna is looking for her fiancé, who is probably in Russian captivity, and volunteering for the East. Kateryna is adapting her family's routine after her military husband's leg amputation. Daria is building her life after losing her husband in the war.

results.title: Language of the Wind
results.overview: The story follows 16-year-old Shatu, who has spent her life tending cattle but secretly longs for city life. The day after her wedding to her traditional cousin Ardo (17), she finds a potential path to escape. As they lead their cattle to graze, the silence and tension between them build into a heavy confrontation of unspoken truths and life-altering decisions on the plains.

results.title: City of Masks
results.overview: Ambition, obsession, and lost love collide in a haunted West End theatre where a disfigured composer, a rising star, and a jealous rival fight for control of a mysterious musical-and the masked legacy that threatens to destroy them all.
